visual_action: A montage of clips and photos from the January 6th Capitol attack. The video begins with a clip of Donald Trump speaking at a rally from a podium with the presidential seal. It then cuts to still images: a large crowd of protestors marching toward the U.S. Capitol, a crowd on the steps of the Capitol as smoke rises, a violent clash between protestors and police in riot gear, and a single Black police officer inside the Capitol building pointing towards unseen rioters.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown speaking at a rally in the opening shot and is explicitly named in the on-screen text: 'Donald Trump tried to overturn the will of the people' and 'Trump attacked democracy.'

on_screen_text.text: Donald Trump tried to overturn the will of the people.
Source: Ashley Gilbertson/VII via Redux, FILE

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue. The audio consists entirely of a song with female vocals. The lyrics heard include 'Try not to abuse your power.'
audio_music: A slow, somber, and melancholic song with female vocals plays throughout the video, creating a serious and mournful tone. The lyrics, including 'Try not to abuse your power,' are used to comment directly on the political actions being depicted.
editing_pacing: The video is a slow-paced slideshow of still photos and one opening video clip, using simple cuts between images to build a narrative.
cultural_references: The soundtrack is the song 'Your Power' by the musician Billie Eilish.
central_claim: On the anniversary of January 6th, Donald Trump is being held responsible for attacking democracy and trying to overturn the will of the people.
intended_effect: To remind viewers of the events of the January 6th Capitol attack and to persuade them that Donald Trump is a threat to American democracy.
